title: perf(console): load the Studio builder and the chart engine with their routes, not on every page (objectui#11798)
body:
Refs #11798 (item: Studio and the chart engine)
Clause-②: no

The console's first authenticated load no longer fetches the Studio builder or the chart engine. Measured below on `main` `455c6466` and on this branch by the same method: 336 → 333 JS chunks, 12,316,677 → 11,572,609 decoded bytes (−6.0%), 3,610,637 → 3,418,259 gzipped (−192,378). The flow designer's canvas could not be moved from inside `apps/console` (why, and the decision it needs, under "Not in this PR"), so this PR is `Part of`, not a closing reference: that half stays open on the card.

## What changed

- **Studio loads with its route.** `StudioRoute.tsx` and `registerStudioComponents.tsx` reach `StudioDesignSurface` and `BuilderLanding` through `import('./studioBuilder')` behind `lazy()`. `apps/console/src/components/studioBuilder.ts` is a console-local module that re-exports the two from `@object-ui/app-shell`, and nothing imports it statically. No package entry or `exports` subpath is added: once no static importer names the two components, the bundler leaves them out of the eager set even though the barrel re-exports them. The entry gate (`StudioRoute` then `RequireStudioAccess`) is unchanged and still decides before the chunk is requested. Fallbacks: the full-screen pillar builder shows `LoadingFallback`, the same splash as the gate's pending state; the `/studio` landing and the `studio:builder` entry show a one-line `common.loading` status inside their frame (`role="status"`).
- **Charts load with the first chart.** The chart engine was eager because of a chunk rule, not an import. `vendor-charts` captured `use-sync-external-store/shim` (a recharts dependency through `react-redux`) by rolldown's default recursive capture, `react-i18next`'s `useTranslation` imports that shim on every page, and so the eager `vendor-i18n` chunk imported `vendor-charts`. `vendor-react` now claims `use-sync-external-store`, and `vendor-charts` keeps its default capture.
- **The eager-closure ledger moves with the bytes.** In `scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs`, `MAX_EAGER_CLOSURE_GZIP_BYTES` goes from 3,637,000 to 3,444,622, down by exactly the 192,378 bytes that left, which keeps the 26,363 bytes (0.29x) of headroom `main` had. `BASELINE` is re-pinned to `c1d378ec` (3,418,259 across 333 of 2456 chunks) in the same commit; the record is the new objectui#11798 entry on that constant. Without the re-pin, `pnpm check:eager-closure` exits 2 on this branch (the aggregate ceiling stood 2.40x the 89 KB regression above the payload). The unit test's rendered-baseline literal moves from 3506.9 to 3338.1. No per-chunk row moved.
- The branch's first commit used `includeDependenciesRecursively: false` on `vendor-charts` instead. A browser control caught it: recharts' other dependencies fell into `plugin-charts`, the two chunks imported each other, and a `chart` node rendered "Failed to load plugin: A is not a function" (build of `8cc10b9`). It is replaced, and the reason is recorded beside the `vendor-react` group.

## Acceptance notes

### First authenticated load, before and after

Method, the same on both sides: Playwright Chromium (`/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`) at 1440x900, a cold context with a signed-in session token, the built console served statically, the API answered by a scratch mock (one admin, one organization, one default app whose home is an object list), landing on `/` and redirected to `/apps/demo_app/account`. Every `.js` response is counted and its decoded body summed; each reading was repeated, identically. `main` was built in this worktree with this branch's three bundler inputs checked out from `455c6466` (blob hashes compared) and `studioBuilder.ts` removed.

| | `main` `455c6466` | this branch | delta |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| JS chunks fetched | 336 | 333 | −3 |
| decoded bytes | 12,316,677 | 11,572,609 | −744,068 (−6.0%) |
| eager closure, gzipped | 3,610,637 | 3,418,259 | −192,378 |
| eager chunks of all chunks | 336 of 2452 | 333 of 2456 | |

The fetched set equals the build's eager closure on both sides, in count and in raw bytes. The chunk count barely moves because 280 (`main`) and 276 (branch) of those chunks are single-icon `vendor-icon-*` chunks; bytes are the measure. The filer's 336 chunks and ~11.7 MB reproduce on `main`.

Per half, each reverted alone on the final tree and built the same way: the chart half is +158,535 gzipped / +583,407 decoded, the Studio half +33,928 / +160,671. Most of `index`'s Studio loss (−72,913 gzipped) is offset by a new `studioScope` chunk (+40,375): 49 modules `index` held on `main` (the app header and the AI chat page among them), split out because the lazy builder imports them too. That is re-attribution, not new payload.

### `pnpm check:eager-closure`

- `main`, with its own constants: exit 0, 3526.0 KB of 3551.8 KB, headroom 25.7 KB.
- This branch before the re-pin: exit 2, aggregate ceiling DRIFTED 2.40x the regression above the payload.
- This branch after the re-pin, on the ordinary console build of `f95872a`: exit 0, 3338.1 KB of 3363.9 KB, headroom 25.7 KB = 0.29x.

### H1 to H3, the dispatch's mechanism hypotheses

- **H1, corrected.** Not the `App.tsx` barrel import as such: the NAMED static imports of `StudioDesignSurface` and `BuilderLanding` from the barrel, in `StudioRoute.tsx` and `registerStudioComponents.tsx`, kept them in the entry chunk. The flow canvas is eager through a different barrel edge: app-shell's package entry imports `views/metadata-admin/register-builtins.ts` for its side effects, which reaches `previews/FlowPreview.tsx` and `previews/FlowCanvas.tsx` (chunk `src`, eager on both sides). Of the "Monaco wiring", only `@monaco-editor/react` and `@monaco-editor/loader` are eager (11 modules, 18,560 rendered bytes, through app-shell's `useMonacoFallback.ts`); `@xyflow` is not in the bundle.
- **H2, falsified for the heavy plugins.** `register-plugins.ts` imports grid, form, view, list and detail eagerly; charts, dashboard, map, gantt, markdown, calendar, timeline and tree are `registerLazy` already, and `plugin-charts` and `plugin-dashboard` source have 0 eager modules on both sides.
- **H3, confirmed for the chart engines.** The `vendor-charts` rule alone made 578 modules (1,305,476 rendered bytes) eager while none of them was statically reachable. One more instance of the class remains, `vendor-markdown`, under "Not in this PR".

### Controls, in the browser, on the ordinary build of `f95872a` with the same mock plus fixtures

- A chart page (`/apps/demo_app/page/chart_page`, one `chart` bar node with inline data): an SVG `.recharts-surface` with its axis labels, `vendor-charts` and `plugin-charts` fetched on demand, no page error. Same on `main`.
- A flow (`/apps/demo_app/metadata/flow/f1`): the flow canvas renders both node cards. Same on `main`.
- Studio: `/studio` renders the landing under its header and fetches `studioBuilder`; `/studio/~org/automations` renders the pillar builder and fetches `studioBuilder`; no page error.

### Pins and reverse checks

- `apps/console/src/components/StudioRoute.lazyBuilder-11798.test.tsx`: a refused principal never evaluates the builder module; the pending window holds it back too; a holder gets it once; the landing renders in its frame from the same module.
- `apps/console/src/__tests__/registerStudioComponents.builderLazy-11798.test.tsx`, renamed from `registerStudioComponents.builderDirect.test.tsx`, whose objectui#5486 assertion (the builder on the first commit) is now the wrong property: `studio:builder` is registered at boot with nothing of the builder evaluated, and its first commit shows the loading status, then the landing.
- The bundle half is pinned by `check:eager-closure`'s re-pinned ceiling. No new gate.
- Reverse, unit: with the Studio source reverted to `main`, predicted 3 failed and 2 passed; observed `Tests 3 failed | 2 passed (5)`. The restore is proven by an empty `git diff HEAD` and matching blob hashes.
- Reverse, gate: the re-pinned `check:eager-closure` on the reverted builds, predicted exit 1 each; observed chart half reverted 3493.0 KB (129.1 KB over), Studio half reverted 3371.3 KB (7.4 KB over), both reverted 3526.0 KB (162.1 KB over). The final tree exits 0.

### Gates run on `f95872a`

- `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/console... --concurrency=2`: 35 of 35 tasks, exit 0 (the console's own `tsc`, `vite build`, manifest and plugin build).
- `pnpm check:eager-closure`: exit 0, above. `pnpm check:eager-locale-catalogues`: exit 0.
- `pnpm exec vitest run` over 52 files that name the touched files (the console's App, AppContent, StudioRoute, registration, register-plugins and loadLocales tests, the two new pins, and every `scripts/__tests__` file that reads `check-eager-closure-budget.mjs` or a vite config): 52 files, 1723 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console type-check`: exit 0; its program includes both new test files.
- `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:shell-escape-residue`, `check:entry-guard`, `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` and `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`: exit 0 each.
- The repo-wide `pnpm lint` and the full test farm are CI's.

## Not in this PR

- **The flow canvas, and with it every metadata-admin designer.** `@object-ui/app-shell`'s package entry imports `views/metadata-admin/register-builtins.ts` for its side effects, and that leaf statically reaches the previews and inspectors: on this branch 162 metadata-admin modules (1,807,259 rendered bytes) are eager, the flow designer's 32 among them (292,151). A console-side `import()` cannot move a side-effect import inside a package entry; only an app-shell change (lazy registration there) or a new subpath export could, and this claim allows neither. Reported on the card as a decision.
- **`vendor-markdown`**, the same chunk-rule class as the charts: 53 of its modules sit in the eager closure without being statically reachable. Reported on the card for the seat.
- `plugin-chatbot` is eager through `SharedRecordPage` and app-shell's AI hooks: a static import, not a chunk rule. Noted only.

Changeset: `.changeset/11798-console-eager-closure.md`, `'@object-ui/console': patch` (the console is in the fixed release group and ships `dist`).
